title: 7yd7 I Emote/Animation Script + UGC
features:
UGC Emotes Roblox GUI

Browse and play over 10K+ UGC emotes directly inside Roblox’s built-in emote menu with full integration

Animation is a side script not a main script

FAQ:

Does it include all emotes?
It includes more than 10K+ emotes. 
Newly released ones may not emote immediately, and some older ones may not emote be available, but all emotes should be present

Is it visual/FE?
Yes. It is a fully visual script, and all features are included
